name: chatgpt-web-midjourney-proxy
description: Full-stack web UI combining ChatGPT + Midjourney/image generation APIs. Vue.js frontend + Node.js backend with Vercel serverless API proxy. NOT an agent skill — requires Node.js/pnpm and API keys.

install.backend: cd service && pnpm install && pnpm start

api_endpoints./api/session: Returns app configuration from environment variables
api_endpoints./api/webdav-proxy: WebDAV CORS proxy for cloud storage sync

env_vars_required.AUTH_SECRET_KEY: Optional: access password for the UI
